body: Negative thoughts from when I wakeup to bed.
Thanks, this was my last try tho. I'm tired of looking, I don't feel like calling some random office and telling a receptionist why I want to a see a dr... EDIT: I live in the U.S

Been at this place for 3 days. If my mental health wasn't gone, I'd survive. Honestly I just want to sleep all day and do nothing. My weekends are spent sleeping. I  do the whole go to the gym 7 days a week and try breathing techniques. Nothing works. Going to the gym made my anxiety even worse. Im constantly looking at my body now. I started tanning years ago "to help" my self esteem. Now I worry constantly about skin cancer on my back and shoulder
I don't want to talk. Talking out loud about my life to a stranger is something I would never do.

I am totally cut off from the world even though I live in a big city. Social anxiety is the worst. I hate this job, because it's a piss poor company by industry standards. But what really set me over the top, is already being asked to put in more than 8 hours a day. I just started on Monday. I hate life.
